verdict.rationale: Termius provides a Keychain vault where credentials (SSH keys, passwords) are stored once and referenced by multiple Hosts and Groups without duplication, backed by Personal and Team vaults synced across devices with encryption. This directly matches the story's core need of centralized credential storage referenced across hosts. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the vault-reference mechanism specifically (community evidence covers general SSH client experience but not this exact vault-reuse workflow), and no detail on encryption specifics beyond marketing claims.
